title: Lens Resolver
tagline: This project resolves lens handles using airstack through a metamask snap.
description:
This project resolves lens handles using airstack through a metamask snap. A key aspect of this project is its ability to map a user-friendly Lens handle to a specific Ethereum address. 

It sets up a separate server to use as the resolver of the address while the metamask snap fetches from the locally running server.
how_its_made: The main functionality lies in the resolveLensHandle function, which queries data using the @airstack/node library to fetch details associated with a given Lens handle. The fetched data contains social information, domain names, primary domains, and addresses associated with the Lens handle. A key aspect of this project is its ability to map a user-friendly Lens handle to a specific Ethereum address.
